meta.notes: A custom status effect, a good one (category beneficial) shown in the colour #a0e0ff. msm:on_tick fires msm_examples:frost_skin_tick every 2 seconds (interval_ticks 40), more often at higher levels (faster_per_level: level II twice as often); it shows snowflakes around the holder. Stat changes (attribute_modifiers): movement speed +20 per cent per level; they are removed when the effect ends. Its icon is textures/mob_effect/frost_skin.png; paint over the drawn picture to restyle it. Custom effects need the Fabric mod jar export.
